message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on a "laundry hauler," a tote bag with plastic sheeting outer surface and wheels. Likely classified in heading 4202 as a travel, sports and similar bag. The candidate subheadings are:

- 4202.92: Travel, sports and similar bags with outer surface of sheeting of plastics or textile materials.
- 4202.12: Trunks, suitcases, and similar containers with an outer surface of plastics or textile materials.

A tote bag with a zipper closure and an outer surface of plastic sheeting falls under 4202.92. Within 4202.92, the options are:

- 4202.92.04 (insulated food or beverage bags)
- 4202.92.08 (Travel, sports and similar bags: with outer surface of sheeting of plastic: Other?)
- 4202.92.15 (with outer surface of sheeting of plastics: Other)
- 4202.92.20 (of vegetable fibers)
- 4202.92.31 (Other: with outer surface of textile materials: of man-made fibers)

The 4202.92 sheeting-of-plastic entries are 4202.92.0210 through 4202.92.0215 and 4202.92.04 for "Sports bags" and similar, and 4202.92.08 for "Other: Travel, sports and similar bags: With outer surface of sheeting of plastics: Other." The statistical suffix for "Other" is 4202.92.9026 or similar. In the current HTS, 4202.92.91 is "Other" (with outer surface of textile materials) and 4202.92.9026 is "Other." For plastic sheeting, "Travel, sports and similar bags" falls under 4202.92.0800 in older schedules, and 4202.92.15 is "Other: with outer surface of sheeting of plastic" (i.e., 4202.92.1500). The later schedule uses 4202.92.9060 for others.

I will go with 4202.92.0800, the plastic-sheeting "Other" provision, with the "Other" provision as my best recollection.
